score.description: Current combined Country Instability Index score for this snapshot, on the source score's scale.

unrest.description: Current unrest contribution carried in the index component state, on the source score's scale.

Error.description: Error is returned when a handler encounters an error. It contains a simple error message that the developer can customize.

message.description: Error message (e.g., 'user not found', 'database connection failed')

FieldViolation.description: FieldViolation describes a single validation error for a specific field.

description.description: Human-readable description of the validation violation (e.g., 'must be a valid email address', 'required field missing')

field.description: The field path that failed validation (e.g., 'user.email' for nested fields). For header validation, this will be the header name (e.g., 'X-API-Key')

country.description: ISO alpha-2 country. Matches either endpoint of a link.

kind.description: sanctions, tariffs, conflict, tension, support, energy, or financial. Omit for all kinds.

limit.description: Maximum number of links. Defaults to 100 and cannot exceed 500.

window.description: 24h or 7d, using the last evidence date. Defaults to 7d.

generatedAt.description: Generation time in epoch milliseconds. Zero indicates no snapshot.. Warning: Values > 2^53 may lose precision in JavaScript

date.description: Optional calendar date in Asia/Seoul, formatted YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for today.

publishedAt.description: Warning: Values > 2^53 may lose precision in JavaScript

lastSeen.description: Warning: Values > 2^53 may lose precision in JavaScript

byCountry.description: Pressure by country and kind, before the request's link limit is applied.

asOf.description: Warning: Values > 2^53 may lose precision in JavaScript

original_keys.description: Top-level keys or shape of the unprojected response.

trackedSince.description: Warning: Values > 2^53 may lose precision in JavaScript

parameters.description: sanctions, tariffs, conflict, tension, support, energy, or financial. Omit for all kinds.

parameters.description: 24h or 7d, using the last evidence date. Defaults to 7d.

parameters.description: Optional JMESPath expression applied server-side to project or reduce the JSON response before it is returned (mirrors the MCP jmespath argument). Invalid expressions, expressions larger than 1024 UTF-8 bytes, or projections that exceed the 256 KB output cap return HTTP 400 with a {_jmespath_error, original_keys} envelope. Grammar and worked examples: https://www.worldmonitor.app/docs/mcp-jmespath.
